name: VAT Input Status
query:
SELECT
    vim.name AS "VAT Input:Link/VAT Input Metadata:150",
    vim.noinvoice AS "Purchase Invoice:Link/Purchase Invoice:150",
    vim.status AS "Status::100",
    vim.transactionid AS "Transaction ID::150",
    vim.nofa AS "No Faktur::120",
    vim.create_vat_response AS "API Response::200",
    vim.vat_upload_success AS "Upload Success:Check:100",
    vim.modified AS "Last Modified:Datetime:150"
FROM
    `tabVAT Input Metadata` vim
WHERE
    vim.docstatus = 0
ORDER BY
    vim.modified DESC
